situation.name: depression_beauty_pressure_peer_influence
situation.description: Mathematical model of depression in young women (ages 15-24) as a function of pressure to be 'beautiful' from media and peers. Four compartments: high vulnerability (V1), low vulnerability (V2), depressed (D), and treatment (T). Peer pressure drives movement between vulnerability classes, media affects high vulnerability class, treatment with relapse.

article.name: A Mathematical Model of Depression in Young Women as a Function of the Pressure to be Beautiful
article.author: Dillon, J.L., Baeza, N., Ruales, M.C., Song, B.

compartments.name: high_vulnerability
compartments.expression: dV1/dt = q*mu*N + epsilon*(V1+D)/N*V2 - delta*V2/N*V1 - alpha*V1 - mu*V1

params.name: total_population
params.meaning: Total population of women aged 15-24 in US (19,936,400)

params.name: high_vulnerability_probability
params.meaning: Probability of being highly vulnerable at age 15 (2/3)

params.name: entry_exit_rate
params.meaning: Per capita entry/exit rate (1/(9*365) per day)

params.name: peer_pressure_high_to_low
params.meaning: Peer pressure rate from high vulnerability and depressed to low vulnerability (0.5/day)

params.name: peer_pressure_low_to_high
params.meaning: Peer pressure rate from low vulnerability to high vulnerability (0.2/day)

params.name: media_influence_rate
params.meaning: Rate media influence causes high vulnerability to become depressed (1/180 per day)

params.name: treatment_seeking_rate
params.meaning: Rate depressed women seek treatment ((1/3)*(1/270) per day)

params.name: treatment_exit_rate
params.meaning: Rate women leave treatment (1/365 per day)
